_comment: Entity alias groups for KB query expansion. Each group lists surface forms of the SAME entity (strict co-reference: alternate names, codenames, short forms) — never merely related entities, so 往生堂 does not map to 胡桃 and 虚空终端 does not map to 世界树. When any member appears in a query, the others are added to the OR side of the FTS query (never the AND side, so precision is unaffected).
